artboards.title: The words · masthead line, title, description

annotations.text:
BRAND · issue #135 on the v0.3 map (#121).
The name is settled (Marchpast, ADR-0020) and the domain is live (marchpast.com, #136), so everything here is drawable and the card can print the domain.
The engraved system of #58 governs: one face, IM Fell English; ink #2b2418 on parchment #efe3c6; the plate's doubled rule; no bold anywhere. The library keeps one look and does not follow the view (map #121), so none of this is themed.

TO DECIDE
1. Which mark: A The Review, B The Cartouche, C The Arrow, D The Rose — or none, and the wordmark alone.
2. Which masthead line, L1 to L4 (the Words sheet). This is the one that matters most: it is now the only thing on the page that explains the app.
3. The social card: S1 the plate behind, or S2 the plate alone.
4. Whether the head carries a third line linking to the story, as drawn, or whether that link stays in the credit footer where the GitHub link already is.
5. The title and the meta description, T1/T2 and D1/D2.

The masthead is drawn at the real measure and the real ramp: 736px container, 56/24/40 padding, name 30, idea 15 italic, the 3px doubled rule under the head, entries at 20/12 with a 1px hairline between — every value read out of src/app/library.css rather than chosen here. The only new things are the mark, the third line, and L2 in place of L1. Four battles are what the library holds today; grouping at seven is #129, not this ticket.
